doctrine_deviation.description: Implementation departs from approved doctrine or reframes the website thesis.

narrative_deviation.description: Implementation departs from the approved narrative sequence or page intent.
narrative_deviation.remediation_required: Re-align sequence and page intent to authority.

design_fidelity_failure.description: Implementation reinterprets or materially diverges from approved design authority.

seo_failure.description: Discoverability implementation fails metadata, sitemap, robots, or structured data expectations.
seo_failure.remediation_required: Correct SEO configuration and evidence gaps.

llm_discoverability_failure.description: Answer-engine discoverability expectations are not met.

performance_failure.description: Performance or Core Web Vitals expectations are not met.
performance_failure.remediation_required: Optimize rendering, asset behavior, and bundle characteristics.

mobile_responsiveness_failure.description: Responsive behavior fails at required mobile or cross-device layouts.
mobile_responsiveness_failure.remediation_required: Correct responsive layout issues and revalidate.

implementation_boundary_failure.description: Required work cannot be completed within allowed write boundaries.
implementation_boundary_failure.remediation_required: Adjust scope or permissions before continuing.

deployment_readiness_failure.description: Release candidate lacks required evidence or production readiness conditions.
deployment_readiness_failure.remediation_required: Complete readiness checks and human review inputs.

design_authority_not_found.description: The required design authority root is missing or inaccessible.
design_authority_not_found.remediation_required: Restore design authority root before continuing.

rejected_wrong_repo_path.description: The current working directory does not match the required repository path.
rejected_wrong_repo_path.remediation_required: Execute from the validated repository path only.

control_plane_failure.description: Control-plane scaffolding is incomplete, inconsistent, or invalid.
control_plane_failure.remediation_required: Repair control-plane artifacts and rerun validation.
